title: Russian finance minister, invited by Trump, draws objections at G-20 meeting
summary_full: As Moscow pounds Ukraine, the appearance by Finance Minister Anton Siluanov was “quite troubling,” said one attendee. U.S. officials cited a need for “dialogue.”
